notes: Tuition: fee is 'None' (0) for all students per the DAAD page. Intakes: deadlines are recurring (winter 15 July, summer 15 January for non-EU applicants); no specific year given. Application deadline according to hs-bremerhaven.de general page for 2026/27 winter semester: 'International applicants who obtained their university entrance qualification outside the EU must apply via the uni-assist portal by January 15, 2026.' but this deadline is not programme-specific and may be for a different semester; therefore not included as fact. Documents for enrolment are listed after admission, not as application requirements; hence omitted from facts. language_proficiency rules: German C1 and English B1 are required (evidence quotes); accepted test lists are from the examples given. The university page states 'Applicants who did not acquire their university entrance qualification at a German-speaking institution need proof of German language skills at level C1 of the Common European Framework of Reference.' and mentions DSH-2 or TestDaF with 16 points, but the DAAD page gives more specific admission conditions for this programme.
